spec2def(deskadp.dll deskadp.spec)

add_rc_deps(deskadp.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/adapter.ico)

# deskadp.dll is all Rust (deskadp-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/deskadp-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# deskadp.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/deskadp-rust/src/deskadp/deskadp.rs)
# shxiface.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/deskadp-rust/src/deskadp/shxiface.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(deskadp_res OBJECT deskadp.rc)
target_compile_definitions(deskadp_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(deskadp_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(DESKADP_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/uuid/libuuid.a)
add_cargo_module(deskadp deskadp-cargo deskadp.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE deskadp-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS deskadp_res ${DESKADP_REUSED})
